svg.title: Marktis Optimizer desktop control-deck redesign preview
svg.desc: Illustrative preview of the refreshed shared Electron and Tauri desktop Main screen, with a cool cyan interface, original geometric artwork, local status cards, and custom line icons.

g.text: A focused workspace for safe, local Roblox settings. Refresh install, Player-process,
hardware, and safety status—never game or session details.
Read-only scan of standard Roblox install locations.
No game, server, account, command-line, or memory data is read.
Enter your numeric Roblox User ID. The public profile opens in your system browser;
the app does not sign in, import, or scrape account data.
Only a public numeric ID is stored locally. No login or private data access.
Before a write, create a timestamped backup and preserve unrelated JSON keys.
Canonical allowlist keys are the default; legacy FPS is an optional request.
DESIGN PREVIEW · SAMPLE STATUS ONLY · NO LIVE GAME METRICS
